import json
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from invoice_json import parse_invoice

class InvoiceNumbers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_precision_and_nested_values(self):
        result = parse_invoice('{"rate": 0.123456789012345678901, "rows": [3.1400, 2e-7, 19]}')
        self.assertIs(type(result['rate']), Decimal)
        self.assertEqual(result['rate'], Decimal('0.123456789012345678901'))
        self.assertEqual(str(result['rows'][0]), '3.1400')
        self.assertIs(type(result['rows'][1]), Decimal)
        self.assertEqual(result['rows'][1], Decimal('2e-7'))
        self.assertIs(type(result['rows'][2]), int)

    def test_other_json_types(self):
        result = parse_invoice('[true, false, null, "4.20", -8]')
        self.assertIs(result[0], True)
        self.assertIs(result[1], False)
        self.assertIsNone(result[2])
        self.assertEqual(result[3], '4.20')
        self.assertIs(type(result[4]), int)

    def test_malformed_document(self):
        with self.assertRaises(json.JSONDecodeError):
            parse_invoice('{"rate":}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
